batch: playtest round 13: the Kroger section becomes the loudest and hardest stop, the junction actually flows, scooters everywhere
share: /Volumes/Adam Assets/Unreal/Builds/Share/The Battle of ATL Mac Playtest 116

packaged_sweep.flake_note: The first packaged sweep returned 15/16 with BattleTroubleAudit failing 'No police spawned on reachable world navigation' (police_spawned=0). It passed twice standalone and passed again in a full clean sweep. Treat it as load-sensitive, not a 116 regression: it was green on packaged 115 and is green on packaged 116 in the recorded run.

what_changed.ask: the kroger needs to be more chaotic peopel dancing riots etc.
what_changed.what: ABattleMurderK became a live landmark instead of static dressing: a collisionless DJ stack and MURDER K DJ sign on the north edge of the apron, a six-person dance party around it using the existing bParkDancer/DanceVariant rigs, an eight-strong rioting crowd on the south edge that is kept panicked and re-centred when it strays, and three bodies on the pavement. The middle of the apron stays clear so the crowd is a hazard, not a wall. Population is topped up every six seconds the way the Krog crash does it.

what_changed.ask: implicit - a crowd shouting needs to read while riding past
what_changed.what: The plaza chants on a rotating subtitle shown by the HUD in the existing bystander slot as CROWD: <chant>, gated to 25 m like the Krog crash shouts and suppressed while a pedestrian curse or a zombie line already owns the slot.

what_changed.ask: its was too easy - i meant the kroger section
what_changed.what: Punk crowd 5/7/9 -> 7/9/11 across Easy/Medium/Hard, a third brawl already in progress on arrival, and a Kroger shooter floor of 1/2/3 so the store is never unguarded. The difficulty table still sets the ceiling.

what_changed.ask: the intersection with the cars had too many cars all parked - that section should see cards driving though some times they stop some times they keep going and the crowd is stopped
what_changed.what: Root cause: CanEnter() counted every ECC_Pawn occupant as a blocker, and pedestrians cross there constantly, so no car ever read the light as green and they all queued as stationary traffic. It now blocks only for ABattleRoadCar and player-controlled pawns. Kerbside walkers are held with PauseRemaining while the light is green or amber; walkers already in the carriageway are left to clear.

what_changed.ask: lets bring in scooters as well
what_changed.what: The difficulty table's Scooters=3 was the whole population. The floor is now 8 moving riders spread across the rideable path splines, so scooters are part of the furniture of the whole route including the junctions.

audit_evidence.junction: RoadCrossingAudit: passed, distance_cm=3998.379 - a walker in the crossing must not hold traffic, a second vehicle must
audit_evidence.editor_sweep: 16/16 green on the editor build before packaging (work/), packaged sweep 16/16 after

audit_contract_changes: BattleMurderKAudit grew from 12 to 15 checks and now asserts the plaza is already a party and a riot before the rider arrives (dancers>=6, rioters>=8, bodies>=3, non-empty chant), plus the new punk counts (7/9/11), three fights, and the Kroger shooter floor.
BattleRoadCrossingAudit now asserts a walker does NOT hold the traffic and a second vehicle does, replacing the old contract that counted any pawn as a blocker.

deliberately_skipped_for_this_build.ask: lets widen the beltlien path its a little too narrow
deliberately_skipped_for_this_build.why: The BeltLine surface is baked geometry, not a runtime parameter. SourceAssets/Terrain/eastside-trail-network.json authors width_game_cm=320 (policy string: 'Authored 320 game cm for arcade play; not a surveyed width'), and that width is baked into 26 OBJ chunks by prepare_eastside_trail.py, imported by install_eastside_trail.py, and mirrored by APiedmontPathSpline::WidthCm for the grass rules. Widening it means re-baking the chunks, re-importing them into PiedmontWorld, updating the beltline and connector spline widths, and re-cooking - a level-geometry change that deserves its own build and its own visual verification rather than riding along with the Kroger work.

still_open: BattleMeleeAudit is a real bug: ResolveMelee() sweeps 185 cm from the camera, which sits 320 cm behind the rider, so melee can only hit things behind him.
BattleDroneAudit (timeout), BattleFrisbeeAudit, BattlePanicAudit, BattleSkaterAudit are red and untouched this round.
BattleRoadContactAudit, BattleKrogRiderAudit and BattleCarLoopAudit still want a quiet machine.
The object Elliott calls 'the logs' is still unexplained. One coordinate plus -BattleSpotReview and -BattlePropProbe names it in a single run.
settings_untouched: No settings menu, option list or saved-settings code was edited, per 'keep all the settings as you have them'. The only HUD edit is the crowd chant line.
